milestone.description:
## Current priority — M7.P5 independent review before H700 and SM8550

The owner has approved engineering firmware transfers and one reboot each for the RG35XX SP, RG SP and Retroid Pocket Nova, plus the named preparation and screenshot checks. #519's controlled RG35XX SP alignment is ACCEPTED before transfer: exact state-bound receipt, all163 protected files/recovery/credentials preserved, stale experimental records archived and automatic cloud sync disabled. Completed alignment, builds, audits and original-image qualification remain accepted; the next changed image receives its own qualification.

All three approved transfers, single reboots, installed-artifact checks, preservation comparisons and reviewed compositor frames are COMPLETE. RG35XX SP accepted15:24UTC, RG SP15:54UTC, Nova16:01UTC, followed by final preservation/frame review. Every original stage/reboot result channel is0 and actual owners exited. Both additional devices have been handed back for normal use. Those deployment/build/audit jobs have ended. The #529 VM investigation is complete; its source delta and next-candidate qualification are recorded below. Nova startup observations are retained under #344: one recovered frontend retry also occurs on the prior build; the early SMMU burst is not assigned a cause or frequency. No physical gameplay/audio claim.

### Current work in order

1. **#548 / #344 — corrected GENERIC_X64 qualification COMPLETE.** Frozen source `1a026648442321609b2288c2c9c06803817f9df2`, identity `0.0.1-dev+20261011T194522Z.g1a0266484423`, ES `c8dc72cf9e`, immutable bundle `bd85b1b42f0170d7d82555af09cbe18762d6fc7eae63293bd0a8043e652db548`. Installed payload, clean startup,14 standard suites/78-frame comparison,108 each WebDAV/SFTP/S3,8 reviewed clean/retained INFORMATION frames and real19→20 upgrade pass. Four save hashes/settings/selection/path/backup survive; retained fresh/108WebDAV/exit/time-to-play pass. Upgrade20 ends0 at20:39:38UTC and all owners/guests/endpoints exited. Original QA20 remains1 for7host-harness failures; final #550/#551 correction passes1378checks/0failures/0skips against the same source. #552 strict acceptance02 ends0, retaining its original parser failure. Explicit composed qualification, never a rewritten original result.
2. **#553 / #554 — independent review complete; four repairs CURRENT.** The one approved Fable5.1/xhigh call completed successfully at21:49:17UTC; model/effort/provenance and all13 leads are verified. Together with the primary review, it identifies four grouped repairs under #554: current evidence bindings (Medium), fork-owned test discovery (Low), historical-readiness diagnostics (Low), and precise pacing/runtime-root comments (Low). No confirmed product defect;44 completed-chain criteria retain PASS and5 existing #528 publication criteria remain PARTIAL. Repair, execute negative controls, verify delivery and close both audit issues before H700 then SM8550. Original failed result channels and historical snapshots remain intact. The approved external call and completed #540 audit are not replayed.
3. **H700, then SM8550.** After delivery/current review gates, freeze the same intended product source, remeasure disk/RAM/swap and supervise build/acceptance. Host swap must be reclaimed only after active QA ends through the guarded helper. Retire superseded test disks only after their last verified dependency under #493. No current build/QA command is running. Earlier owner deployments and their consumed permissions are not replayed.
4. **#528 / #344 / #265 / #337 / #359 — publication completion.** Engineering component dispositions are delivered, retaining all capabilities. Shader/ABL aggregate terms, vendor/prebuilt/source coverage, final-image inventory, independent retrieval/off-host custody, bot/runner readback, adoption/recovery/support/SSH/cloud/source notes, channel separation, per-asset physical smoke and named publication authority still hold publication. Public naming remains0.0.1-rc.N then0.0.1; no RC allocated here.

Replacement19 qualification is complete for its own source: standard/protocol with explicitly composed fixes, real retained upgrade/save hashes, clean/retained connection controls, public ROCKNIX configuration preservation, native/service/consent/USB checks,22 reviewed UI/startup frames and actual same-model/foreign archive/manual-folder proof. #531 and #541–547 are closed; original failing aggregates remain unchanged. New-image runtime proof above is still required. [Installed UI/startup evidence](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/3fcff2e1e2f9c8502e04180a5db2036bd4016497/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-installed-ui).

**#533 reconciliation:** the original18 open M7 issues and four bugs were mapped; new #535–#539 and audit #540 are dispositioned above; #537 is closed with the completed combined-image qualification above. #534 is a preserved fixed LED-color selection, with read-only diagnosis recorded; #535 open-network password handling is source/VM-qualified and closed. #352 delivered; #353 automatic migration retired; #510 qualified; #354 consolidated into #344. #350 exact-image proof is complete; #349 public docs remain under #511; #395 moves to explicit backlog, while active supervision remains mandatory. Full disposition, original contract mapping, exact proposed pins, source-bound evidence, watcher and retirement plan: [next candidate scope](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/releases/next-candidate-scope.md).

**Completed device work:** #519 alignment and the authorized RG35XX SP, RG SP and Nova transfers/reboots/readbacks are complete. Devices are in owner use; automatic startup/game-exit sync remains off. No new physical action is authorized by this planning update.

**Parallel #511:** website/setup/ROM/BIOS guides stay in their separate Herdr lane; startup trust remains that lane's question. Local instructions work without a live site. **Personal #516:** optional residue cleanup remains separate; no bulk cloud cleanup or first sync is implied. #519 no longer awaits approval or execution.

## Completed qualification — retain, do not rerun

- **#510/#515/#520/#521/#522/#523:** settled post-rclone contract and finite layout disposition; preserve selected independent paths, no automatic cloud-folder move/follow. Source, target-native capture dependencies, explicit modes and reviewed flow/frame references are published. Unsupported ROM/BIOS layouts retain instructions. Linking a backend is not relocation consent (D-CLOUD-175/176/178/179).
- **#507/#524:** independent primary plus both approved Fable5.1/xhigh reviews, all four fixes, resolution evidence and exact-head hosted checks completed; both issues closed. Earlier candidate16 audit #471 also remains complete. Do not repeat external transfers.
- **#508/#526/#527:** final source/installed CF10/public-configuration preservation and real retained-storage upgrade are qualified. Replacement18 has13 unaffected standard suites plus separately qualified corrected walks and composed78-frame comparison. The original qa-21 aggregate rc1 remains unchanged; this is composed qualification, not a relabelled original run. WebDAV/SFTP/S3 each108 assertions (324total); candidate16→18 upgrade31checks. All16 corrected frames reviewed at640×480/1280×800; no baseline or blanket-mask change. Source/canonical flow/EN-FR branch evidence is retained.
- **#492:** H70002 and SM855003 engineering firmware and final inventories accepted; issue closed. Both use distribution `8b5113fa164ada7d002ab138b1e3a9bf795e9de5` and ES `1d76b3da7da75794066df1c089931b890304da7a`. H700 ARM244/aarch64671 and SM8550 ARM245/aarch64737 tasks completed. All original final build/acceptance channels0, actual owners/container exited. Original failed attempts remain failures. Those qualification jobs are complete; #529 is a separate startup investigation.

Qualification: [replacement18](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-pixelelated-replacement-18/qualification.md), [corrected walks](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-cloud-folder-walks), [device artifacts](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-device-refresh), [final inventories](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-final-inventory).

## Exact firmware and source custody

H70002 bundle `1b93642b24901b5c3a96b0a079d6fb4486ca30d213b4b2db890c6e3630404175`; TAR `b49cca4ca0b8996fa994181508c887d9df5afe155c9502919bab7bf7e153e39d`. Both DDR variants/update bytes,185 ARM handoff files, native helpers/catalog/post-update/identity pass.

SM855003 bundle `afcb966f246118798c87e59cd5bc6ce7c2c21167a5d712faea56393409d9d79d`; TAR `b3f1a8190e04abbf64d35486601ee19fce35d2d25bc7239b1be7cccd9fb43730`. Raw/update equality, GPT, all5 ABL files,187 ARM handoff files and14 FEX outputs pass. Two changed ARM outputs in each build differ only in bounded embedded revision/date/time strings; exact new bytes were accepted.

All2,327 component/profile rows (701 distinct components) map to local retained inputs:605 exact archives/9.04GB,372 Git snapshots,43 roots,439 submodule edges, frozen distribution recipes/patches and separately retained prebuilt sources. Only Teakra's unused test LFS payload is omitted with explicit source/build-edge disposition. This inventory is not complete corresponding-source/licence clearance.

The current notice basis is `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-09-notice-scope/licence-basis-corrected.json`.13of17 have some root/scoped evidence, not13 cleared components. GLSL's LGPL notice belongs to nnedi3, not the entire collection. Common/GLSL/RetroPie/slang shaders and ABL lack an established aggregate basis. rclone's embedded revision matches retained source but reports modified=true; Tailscale's version/tag evidence is not a reproducible-binary proof. ABL packaging is not implementation source; LinuxLoader `4588733123554b1f7bf935b04e494e4284894546` returned404 to blitterbot. Owner source/contact question remains pending; no upstream outreach occurred. IntendedB2 remains subject to the owner's comparison (D-WORKFLOW-107); no bucket or purchase inferred.

## Explicitly outside this release

Infrastructure topology/restore drill #347/#348/#355; replacement runner/inherited-code review #336/#339/#346; general audit-depth policy #378; device telemetry #387 and FOSS build-observability evaluation #432; disconnected notifications #395; RA fixture reset automation #464/#240; optional Dropbox/offsite QA #463; active-name cleanup #509; personal redundancy #518; broader site/trademark work. Existing release custody requirements still apply. D-INFRA-022 retains only immediate-test payloads plus durable compact evidence and required source custody. No RC designation or public publication clearance is claimed.

body:
## Audit repair scope

Parent #344, independent review #553, M7.P5. The owner approved: “You have my approval to send the packet and conduct the audit”. Their standing requirement is to resolve discovered gaps before the next builds.

The verified Fable5.1/xhigh review and primary adjudication identify four repair items:0 Critical,0 High,1 Medium,3 Low. Original implementation score remains44 PASS/5 existing #528 PARTIAL after the binding probes. No confirmed product runtime defect. Existing #528 publication/source/custody work remains separately tracked.

Can this be done on the VM? These are host qualification tools, comments and audit evidence. Local isolated negative/positive fixtures and byte-level checks are the appropriate platform; no physical device or private cloud action is required. Already written: no device/cloud mutation is introduced by these repairs; existing VM/runtime results are retained without rewriting failed originals.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] PL-001: A command rehashes every supplemental artifact, validates the current rclone recipe/archive bindings and retained publication hold, verifies the original upgrade manifest and all three original build20 rc2 channels, and counts14 recipe files for13 names.
- [x] PL-002: The fixed real runner executes12 passing fork tests despite an injected failing upstream method, automatically includes an added fork test (13 passing), and still rejects the wrong cooldown duration.
- [x] PL-003: All7 readiness controls pass; historical/missing-function, unterminated-function and unreadable-file controls exit2 with a meaningful diagnostic and no traceback.
- [x] PL-004: The patch diff payload is byte-identical before/after; vm-pair changes are comments only, shell syntax and all9 launch controls pass; current references no longer hardcode custom sockets under/tmp.

## Detailed punch list

# Punch list — post-review component and qualification changes

Source: [04-analysis.md](04-analysis.md). Audit tracking: #553.

Four audit-discovered items: 0 Critical, 0 High, 1 Medium, 3 Low. All four are resolved in published commit `9f170ee74150607116c8ed37f9ee17df394bbcfb`. No confirmed product runtime defect; no device build starts before these repairs and the audit closeout pass.

Can this be done on the VM? These repairs affect host qualification tools, source comments and audit evidence. Local isolated fixtures and byte-level artifact checks are the appropriate platform; no physical device or account is involved. Existing installed clean/retained VM qualification remains explicitly source-bound.

## PL-001: Bind the audit to current and complete evidence

- **Severity:** Medium
- **Category:** Missing Artifact
- **Source finding:** G-01 (F-1, F-2, F-3, F-4, F-13)
- **Owner area:** audit evidence and component dispositions
- **What:** Add the current rclone1.75.2 binding without rewriting old dispositions; link the executed upgrade manifest/diff, actual original build failures, pinned container controls, tracker closure readbacks, freshness and source/fixture/image evidence; distinguish13 names from14 recipes.
- **Where:** 02-forward-audit.md; 04-analysis.md; docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-component-inputs/
- **Why:** A current verdict must identify the exact constituent artifacts and their limits.
- **Evidence:** checks/adjudication/source-probes.json; rehearsal.diff; supplemental-evidence.json; unfiltered-head.txt
- **Acceptance:** A command rehashes every supplemental artifact, validates the current rclone recipe/archive bindings and retained publication hold, verifies the original upgrade manifest and all three original build20 rc2 channels, and counts14 recipe files for13 names.

## PL-002: Discover fork tests without importing upstream test methods

- **Severity:** Low
- **Category:** Test Gap
- **Source finding:** G-02 (F-9)
- **Owner area:** proxy integration qualification
- **What:** Collect methods owned by fork-defined unittest classes, including new fork classes, and exclude imported/inherited upstream test methods.
- **Where:** tools/raofflineproxy-integration-test:233
- **Why:** Upstream fixture changes must not silently change the fork test count or run unrelated assertions.
- **Evidence:** checks/adjudication/pix553-lead-tests02/upstream-injected.log: original14 tests,2 injected failures
- **Acceptance:** The fixed real runner executes12 passing fork tests despite an injected failing upstream method, automatically includes an added fork test (13 passing), and still rejects the wrong cooldown duration.

## PL-003: Report unsupported historical rehearsal input cleanly

- **Severity:** Low
- **Category:** Code Quality
- **Source finding:** G-03 (F-12)
- **Owner area:** upgrade readiness qualification
- **What:** Validate the source read and complete wait_for_storage function boundary before extracting it; return a clear CLI diagnostic on missing, incomplete or unreadable input.
- **Where:** tools/vm-upgrade-readiness-test:14
- **Why:** Historical negative runs should fail deliberately rather than by an uncaught IndexError.
- **Evidence:** checks/adjudication/pix553-lead-tests02/old-rehearsal.log: original traceback/exit1
- **Acceptance:** All7 readiness controls pass; historical/missing-function, unterminated-function and unreadable-file controls exit2 with a meaningful diagnostic and no traceback.

## PL-004: Describe proxy pacing and VM ownership paths precisely

- **Severity:** Low
- **Category:** Documentation Gap
- **Source finding:** G-04 (F-8, F-10)
- **Owner area:** proxy patch and VM helper documentation
- **What:** Clarify deliberate per-ROM request throttle/batch cooldown versus background queue pacing; document the shared custom runtime root and requirement to retain the same owner environment for shutdown.
- **Where:** projects/ROCKNIX/packages/network/raofflineproxy/patches/004-no-cap-on-cached-games.patch:3; tools/vm-pair:17
- **Why:** Descriptions must match the preserved behavior and must not imply discovery of unrelated owners.
- **Evidence:** rom_browser.py requested>0 pace condition; checks/adjudication/literal-socket-search.txt
- **Acceptance:** The patch diff payload is byte-identical before/after; vm-pair changes are comments only, shell syntax and all9 launch controls pass; current references no longer hardcode custom sockets under/tmp.

## Pre-existing tracked scope (not punch items)

#528: source/licence/vendor/retrieval/off-host custody; #349/#511: public documentation; #265/#337/#359: release/publication and physical gates. These remain tracked independently and are not deferred audit findings.

## Phase 7 resolution gate

| Item | Outcome | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PL-001 | Resolved | `9f170ee74150607116c8ed37f9ee17df394bbcfb`; #554; `checks/repairs/evidence-result.json`:25 receipts,8 upgrade inputs,10 applied/frozen modules, current rclone hashes, original2/2/2;13 names/14 recipes. |
| PL-002 | Resolved | `9f170ee74150607116c8ed37f9ee17df394bbcfb`; #554; `checks/repairs/result.json`:12 baseline,12 with failing upstream injection,13 new-fork, wrong cooldown12/1failure. |
| PL-003 | Resolved | `9f170ee74150607116c8ed37f9ee17df394bbcfb`; #554; `checks/repairs/result.json`:7 states pass;5 invalid-source controls exit2 without traceback. |
| PL-004 | Resolved | `9f170ee74150607116c8ed37f9ee17df394bbcfb`; #554; `checks/repairs/result.json`:unchanged patch payload, comments-only pair, syntax and9 launch controls pass. |

## Delivered resolution
